info.title: smith
info.description: Runs a monorepo in Node, Go, Python, Rust, .NET, Ruby, PHP, C++, Dart, the JVM and Bicep: tasks from a cache, CI and releases

x-inspectra.cliParsedDescription:

generates CI pipelines, and releases packages from conventional commits.
